calculation.description: Fade each instrument's five-day return relative to the same-day cross-sectional median, activated only when cross-sectional five-day dispersion exceeds its trailing 60-observation median. Cross-sectional z-normalization makes the signal comparable across dates. All inputs are lagged at decision time.

validation.regime_notes: Strong in 2020-2024 and negative in 2025-2027; admission is supported by full-period daily IC and ICIR but recent drift requires quarterly revalidation. Small 15-instrument universe and conditional activation warrant conservative interpretation.
